answer: Reputation escrow with delayed settlement: each agent's earnings route through a quartz-timestamped ledger, holding payouts for a cooldown before release. The enforcement rule ties withdrawal to accumulated work history, so a fresh clone starts at zero and its held funds sit in a vault nobody can spend early. Cloning costs an attacker a full cooldown and forfeited pending income per identity, sunk like water into karst. Honest agents pay only time.
